title: Inbox sweep node declaration
description: One nodes/<id>.node.json per node (design section 15.1, spec node-declarations). The declaration is what code reads; the design tables describe it and `make nodes-check` fails when they disagree.

id.description: R1 to R7 run DAG, L1 to L12 reply DAG, S1 to S7 lead stage

version.description: semver; bumped on every change to the file

script.description: repo-root relative path of the script that runs the node, or the actor when no script does

serial.description: null when the node runs in parallel; otherwise the reason it must be serial. An empty or missing reason fails `make bottleneck-check` (design section 16), which is why the schema does not forbid the empty string: the schema says what shape, the check says what is acceptable.
